question: Should this draft remain a stacked feed/follow/notification PR, or should it be split so this PR only lands public publisher feed routes after the follow graph PRs are reviewed?
rationale: The title is feed-route focused, but the branch includes durable follow graph, notification fanout, public API, and UI changes that overlap related open drafts and require maintainer ownership of rollout order.

options.title: Restack and prove the full stack
options.body: Keep the full branch scope, resolve conflicts against main and the related drafts, and require real Convex/browser proof before merge.

options.title: Split to feed routes only
options.body: Reduce this PR to canonical feed URLs and metadata, leaving follow graph and notification fanout to narrower related PRs.

options.title: Pause until direction is confirmed
options.body: Leave the draft parked until maintainers decide the account/publisher feed product boundary and API rollout sequence.

recommendation.title: Restack and prove the full stack
recommendation.body: Keep the full branch scope, resolve conflicts against main and the related drafts, and require real Convex/browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history across the publisher routes, schema route constants, and adjacent surfaces this stacked feature extends.
